videos.title: I Lived With You
videos.description: 1933. Drama. Stars: Ursula Jeans, Ida Lupino & Minnie Rayner. A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Gladys who takes him home to live with her folks. Co-written by Ivor Novello.

videos.title: Scotland Yard
videos.description: The Dover Road Mystery. Directed by Gerard Bryant. Starring Geoffrey Keen, Edward Cast and Leonard Sachs. A stolen car used in a bank robbery proves too fast for the squad car. (S1, E.

videos.title: William Tell
videos.description: 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Accused of murdering a partisan helper and stealing his gold, Tell must find a way to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Object Z
videos.description: 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Brandon Brady & Terence Donovan. The British public begin to build shelters. Meanwhile in Australia, a 1000 mega ton bomb is launched at Object Z.

videos.title: William at the Circus
videos.description: Episode 2. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William attempts to raise money to ensure all the boys can go on a trip to London to visit Downing Street.

videos.title: There Was An Old Woman Who Lived In A Shoe
videos.description: 1940. A wonderful animated short film directed by George Pal featuring a twist on the classic nursery rhyme.

videos.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
videos.description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & George Barnes. Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away.

videos.title: The Lone Ranger
videos.description: 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Gene Roth. While on the trail, Tonto gets an urgent message to meet Chief Swift Eagle.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The US Navy are testing a new bathyscaphe when disaster strikes. The Supercar team spring into action to save the trapped crew.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Eddie Byrne & Nigel Davenport. Robin and Friar Tuck escort Marian to Ireland to search for her uncle and encounter a monstrous priest.

videos.title: Zontar - Thing From Venus
videos.description: 1967. Sci-fi. Directed by Larry Buchanan. Stars John Agar, Susan Bjurman & Tony Huston. A young scientist believes an alien from Venus can help Earth but soon discovers it has a malevolent plan.

videos.title: The Blue Lamp
videos.description: 1949. Crime. Directed by Basil Dearden. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Jack Warner & Jimmy Hanley. A killer shoots a London policeman during a robbery.

videos.title: Scales of Justice
videos.description: Company of Fools. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Barrie Ingham. Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially. (S1, E.

videos.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
videos.description: 1954. Romantic Comedy. Director: Jean Negulesco. Stars Dorothy McGuire & Jean Peters. Three women toss coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain for luck in romance. But none have the luck they hoped for.

videos.title: Look At Life Caught in the Cold
videos.description: 1963. A look at the chaos brought in by ice and snow each year in Britain, why it happens in an age of scientific miracles and what is being done about it.

videos.title: Dick Turpin
videos.description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Jennie Linden. Turpin and Swiftnick try to help a mysterious woman who is being blackmailed by Captain Spiker, but they are led into a trap.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Neville Jason. An old, dilapidated mansion is burgled and Maigret discovers a disturbing reason why a family is reluctant to talk.

videos.title: Lillie
videos.description: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. Visiting Crown Prince Rudolf becomes smitten with Lillie, prompting Bertie to arrange for Lillie to be presented to the Queen.

videos.title: The Paper Chase
videos.description: 1973. Comedy Drama. Directed by James Bridges. Stars Timothy Bottoms, Lindsay Wagner & John Houseman. A law student learns that his tyrannical professor is also the father of the student he loves.

videos.title: Confessions of a Pop Performer
videos.description: 1975. Comedy. Director: Norman Cohen. Stars Robin Askwith, Anthony Booth & Bill Maynard. The adventures of accident-prone, amorously inclined Timmy Lea, as he tries to achieve pop music stardom.

videos.title: EuroTrash
videos.description: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, special guests include Avari, Celebrity Flasher: Adriana Sklenarikova, Gunther Brendel, Philip Mond, Coumba Gawlo and Lolo Bounces Up and Down.

videos.title: Yanky Panky
videos.description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

videos.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
videos.description: 1977. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Suzy Kendall, Harry H. Corbett. While his boss is away, Bob helps a model being blackmailed, finds a dead body & ends up in a cabaret club.

videos.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Island
videos.description: 1952. Stars Charles Boyer, Dick Powell, Joel McCrea and David Niven. George catches a shady doctor using a fake name. George falls sick and must be operated on by him.

videos.title: Look At Life Box on the Wall
videos.description: 1960. A look behind the scenes of industry, exploring what is being done to improve Britain's output.

videos.title: One Step Beyond
videos.description: 1960. Stars Jean Allison, Dennis Patrick & Ted Knight. In Hawaii, a tsunami threatens a wheelchair bound woman, will anyone be able to help save her.

videos.title: All Living Things
videos.description: Drama. 1955. Directed by Victor M. Gover. Stars Patrick Barr, Helen Christie & Ian Fleming. An incident with his son and his dog changes the mind of a Professors uses of animals in his research.

videos.title: The Man In The Mirror
videos.description: 1936. Drama with Edward Everett-Horton & Alastair Sim. A timid businessman, while looking into his mirror, is confronted by his alter ego.

videos.title: Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: The Case of the French Interpreter. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When an interpreter says he was kidnapped, Sherlock investigates further.

videos.title: Our Man in Havana
videos.description: 1960. Comedy. Director: Carol Reed. Stars Alec Guinness, Maureen O'Hara & Burl Ives. Vacuum cleaner salesman Jim agrees to work as an agent and recruit agents for the British Secret Service.

videos.title: Scotland Yard
videos.description: Night Crossing. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, John Serret and Andre Maranne. The quiet of an idyllic port town is shattered when a body is found on the beach.

videos.title: Salvage with a Smile 1940
videos.description: 1940. Second World War comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner, made at Ealing Studios.

videos.title: Reach For The Sky
videos.description: 1956. War drama. Directed by Lewis Gilbert and stars Kenneth More, Muriel Pavlow and Lyndon Brook. This is the true story of Douglas Bader, who loses his legs but returns to flight during WW2.

videos.title: Water World
videos.description: 2000. Join Timothy West as actor David Suchet joins the battle to save a stretch of historic Midlands canal threatened by a new road and conservationists try to rescue the native water voles.

videos.title: That's My Boy
videos.description: 1986. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Harold Goodwin. Ida becomes distraught when Wilfred disappears, but there is more drama when he is found.

videos.title: For the Love of Ada
videos.description: Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack. A gentleman admirer starts flirting with Ada and she is flattered but what does Walter think to all this. (S4, E.

videos.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
videos.description: Part One. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Vera Miles. U.N.C.L.E. and THRUSH race against each other in a bid to get hold of a machine that reverses aging.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: Pete Murray gives the lowdown on the New Musical Express, join Noel for 'Home Movie Day' at London's Cinema Museum and there's ballroom dancing at the Hammersmith Palais in the swinging 60s.

videos.title: Enemy At The Door
videos.description: 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall & Emily Richard. Officer Von Bulow comes to the island and is billeted with Peter whilst he trains soldiers for the Russian front.

videos.title: Will Success Spoil Rock Hunter?
videos.description: 1957. Comedy. Director: Frank Tashlin. Stars Tony Randall, Jayne Mansfield & Joan Blondell. An ad man and a famous Hollywood actress must pretend to be a couple as part of an advertising campaign.

videos.title: Look At Life Signpost of The Sea
videos.description: 1960. A fascinating look at the lighthouses and light-ships around Britain's coast.

videos.title: Fox
videos.description: Just Another Villain in a Cheap Suit. 1980. Stars Derrick O'Connor, Larry Lamb, Dilys Lane & Trudie Goodwin. Ray is asked to repay an old debt he would rather forget.

videos.title: The Boys From Brazil
videos.description: 1978. Drama. Directed by Franklin J. Schaffner. Stars Gregory Peck, Laurence Olivier & James Mason. A Nazi hunter in Paraguay discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.

videos.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
videos.description: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

videos.title: Crosstrap
videos.description: 1962. Crime Drama. Directed by Robert Hartford-Davis. Starring Laurence Payne and Jill Adams. Husband and wife look forward to their vacation but get caught between rival jewel thieves.

videos.title: The Public Enemy
videos.description: 1931. Crime Drama. Directed by William A. Wellman. Stars James Cagney, Jean Harlow, Edward Woods & Joan Blondell. A compelling story about the rise and fall of two young Chicago hoodlums.

videos.title: Make a Meal of Cheese
videos.description: 1973. A wonderful promotional film issued by the Cheese Information Service, featuring some familiar faces.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: 1956. Stars Richard Greene, James Hayter & Laurence Hardy. Tom the local baker believes his mill is haunted and seeks the help of Robin, but he suspects other forces are at work.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The US Navy are testing a new bathyscaphe when disaster strikes. The Supercar team spring into action to save the trapped crew.

videos.title: The Vise
videos.description: 1955. Stars Ron Randall, Kay Callard & Leslie Phillips. Penny cannot decide between dependable George or wealthy Mark but while on a walk together, George falls to his death.

videos.title: The Detectives
videos.description: Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

videos.title: Murder At 3am
videos.description: 1953. Crime drama. Director: Francis Searle. Starring Dennis Price, Philip Saville and Peggy Evans. A serial killer on the loose makes a habit of murdering women on the street at precisely 3am.

videos.title: Ladies of Leisure
videos.description: 1930. Romantic Drama. Directed by Frank Capra. Stars Barbara Stanwyck, Ralph Graves, Lowell Sherman. Wealthy artist Jerry Strong hires a good girl with a bad past as a model, and romance follows.

videos.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
videos.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout December.

videos.title: Z-Cars
videos.description: 1976. Stars Allan O'Keefe & Jeffrey Kissoon. The public expect to be protected by the police. But if a policeman kills a member of the public, will the protector be protected.

videos.title: Son of a Stranger
videos.description: 1957. Drama. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars James Kenney, Ann Stephens & Victor Maddern. A young man searches for the father he never knew, with the belief that he is a rich aristocrat.

videos.title: Soundie - Betty Brewer
videos.description: 1941. The wonderful Betty Brewer sings I'm Gonna Sit Right Down and Write Myself a Letter.

videos.title: Richard the Lionheart
videos.description: 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Margaretta Scott & Christopher Witty. The young prince of England is to visit his uncle, King Richard. His escort is a kidnapper and takes his place.

videos.title: Five Days
videos.description: 1954. Crime. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Stars Dane Clark, Cecile Chevreau & Paul Carpenter. A man on the verge of bankruptcy pays his friend to organise a hit on him, but will his plan pay off.

videos.title: Look At Life Cause for Alarm
videos.description: 1960. A look at modern technology and how it is used to help make life harder for lawbreakers.

videos.title: Film Noir
videos.description: 2022. The 1940s and 50s were the heyday of Film Noir. This new style which had developed from the days of silent film and German Expressionism was now reaching its peak in Hollywood.

videos.title: This Happy Breed
videos.description: 1944. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Robert Newton, Celia Johnson, John Mills & Stanley Holloway. After WW1, a family lead an ordinary sort of life until the outbreak of WW2.

videos.title: Scales of Justice
videos.description: Company of Fools. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Barrie Ingham. Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially. (S1, E.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: Four and her Children. 1999. Stars Bruno Cremer, Marianne Basler & Christian Morin. Maigret investigates a chemist's wife who accused her husband of murder and claimed to have seen a corpse.

videos.title: Murders In...
videos.description: Murders in Sarlat - Meurtres à Sarlat. 2017. Director: Delphine Lemoine. Stars Cecile Bois & Thierry Godard. The son of the region's largest manufacturer of preserved foods has been murdered.

videos.title: The Lawless Years
videos.description: 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert Karnes, Milton Frome & Paul Genge. Ruditsky won't take a bribe when a couple of criminals are implicated in a crime, so their gang attempts to frame him.
